paragraphs1: Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for registering for the 2026 Impact Asia Alliance Summit - the Phoenix International Leadership Summit. Your registration is more than a decision to attend an international gathering. It is a willingness to step into a journey of seeking direction and receiving a renewed sense of mission for a world undergoing rapid change.
As the whole world races toward the future, we need to pause and seek God:
heading1: Where is the future leading us?
paragraph2: Artificial intelligence is changing the world at an unprecedented pace. It is redefining work, education, media, and industry, while also challenging our understanding of human value, dignity, and calling. As technology grows ever more powerful, our need for wisdom and direction from God becomes even greater. At this moment, when digital civilization is transforming humanity, God is still looking for those who are willing to answer:
quotes: “I have entrusted this world to you. How will you steward it?”
paragraph3: Thank you for responding. Thank you also for preparing to join us in the desert of Phoenix for an unforgettable wilderness journey of calling and renewal.
paragraph4Intro: From this moment forward, we warmly invite you to prepare not only your travel plans, but also your heart. Please continue to pray for this international summit:
prayerList: May God Himself gather those He has chosen from different nations, cities, generations, and spheres of influence to come to Phoenix.
May every speaker and ministry team carry a message, vision, and love that come from God.
May every encounter and conversation become a new connection across nations, generations, and fields of service.
May we become still again in the wilderness and hear God's call for our lives, our cities, the Church, and the world.

And when we leave Phoenix, may we carry home more than notes, photographs, or a passing moment of inspiration. May we return with a clear mission, a genuine response, and a covenant with God for the future.
heading2: Before arriving in Phoenix, we invite you to reflect prayerfully on these questions:
reflectionList: Ten years from now, what do I hope to have contributed to this world?
What concrete action will I bring home from Phoenix?
Who are the people, and what are the city and sphere of influence, that God has entrusted to me?
closingBold: Not everyone has the opportunity to see that light in the wilderness of Phoenix. Nor does every generation have the privilege of standing at a turning point in human civilization and responding to God's call for the world.
paragraphs5: Thank you for choosing to walk with us.
May we enter the wilderness together in prayer and see that light in the desert.
May that light illuminate us anew, so that when we return to our nations and cities,
we may become a light for this generation.
We look forward to welcoming you in Phoenix.
